Two children drown while bathing in rivers in separate incidents

Two separate incidents of drowning have been reported involving young boys. In Umaria, an 8-year-old boy drowned while bathing with friends at the Binduli river ghat. In Surajpur, a 10-year-old boy drowned after jumping into the Ghunghutta river and his body was found half a kilometer away the following day.
